entities.name: Table T1 – Global Data Center Infrastructure Potential Shortfall in US Data Center Power 2025-28
entities.brief: Waterfall chart of US data center power shortfall 2025-28
entities.description: Illustrates projected 45 GW power deficit after accounting for construction and grid capacity

properties.table_content:
| Category | Value (GW) |
|-----------------------------------|------------|
| US Power Needed, 2025-28          | 65         |
| US DCs Under Construction         | (6)        |
| Available US Grid Capacity        | (15)       |
| Potential Shortfall               | (45)       |
properties.key_insight: Despite 6 GW from new data centers and 15 GW grid capacity, there is a 45 GW shortfall against 65 GW demand for US data centers 2025-28.
